name: hippocampal grey matter
description: Grey matter of the subiculum and CA1-CA4 (cornu Ammonis), the domain of the hipp Laplace coordinates.
laplace_role: hipp domain (AP, PD, IO); dentate IO src

name: SRLM or 'dark band'
description: Stratum radiatum, lacunosum and moleculare with the vestigial hippocampal sulcus: the hypointense band separating hippocampal grey matter from the dentate gyrus.
laplace_role: hipp IO src (inner surface); dentate IO sink

name: neocortex (entorhinal or parahippocampal)
description: Medial temporal lobe cortex adjoining the subiculum.
laplace_role: hipp PD src; dentate IO src

name: pial surface
laplace_role: hipp IO src; dentate IO sink

name: hippocampal-amygdalar transition area
description: Anterior (head) end of the hippocampus, where it meets the amygdala.

name: indusium griseum
description: Posterior (tail) end of the hippocampus, continuing as the indusium griseum.

name: cysts
description: Cysts, typically remnants of the hippocampal sulcus, treated like SRLM.
laplace_role: hipp IO src; dentate IO sink

name: dentate gyrus
description: Dentate gyrus grey matter (granule cell and molecular layers), the domain of the dentate Laplace coordinates.
laplace_role: dentate domain (AP, PD, IO); part of the hipp domain (with 1); hipp PD sink

name: dentate gyrus PD source
description: Exposed free edge of the dentate gyrus at the surface of the hippocampus (margo denticulatus), bordering the outside of the hippocampus (label 0) and hippocampal grey matter.
laplace_role: dentate PD src; hipp and dentate IO sink

name: dentate gyrus PD sink
description: Buried end of the dentate gyrus inside the hilus, enclosed by CA4 grey matter (label 1) and the SRLM (label 2).
laplace_role: dentate PD sink; hipp IO src; dentate IO sink

name: alveus
description: White matter covering the outer (ventricular) surface of the hippocampus, carrying hippocampal efferents to the fimbria. Not labelled in all templates and segmentation models; where absent, the hippocampus borders background (label 0) there.
